[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''792.203/S60''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] assigned to the [[Garrison/Legends|garrisonon]] [[Koovis]]. The commander was responsible for detaining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Klev Natasken]] and holding him for transfer to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].
